title: AHA Guidelines for Type 2 Diabetes Management
content: These are the AHA guidelines for the management of Type 2 Diabetes. Key recommendations include: Metformin is generally recommended as first-line therapy. Lifestyle modifications are crucial, including diet and exercise. Consider SGLT2 inhibitors or GLP-1 receptor agonists for patients with established cardiovascular disease. For more detailed information, consult the official AHA publications.

title: General Guidelines for Type 2 Diabetes Management
content: These are the General guidelines for the management of Type 2 Diabetes. Key recommendations include: Start with Metformin. Encourage healthy eating and regular physical activity. For more detailed information, consult the official General publications.

title: AHA Guidelines for Hypertension Management
content: These are the AHA guidelines for the management of Hypertension. Key recommendations include: Thiazide diuretics, ACE inhibitors, ARBs, or calcium channel blockers are first-line options. Lifestyle changes are paramount for blood pressure control. Regular monitoring of blood pressure is essential. For more detailed information, consult the official AHA publications.

title: General Guidelines for Hypertension Management
content: These are the General guidelines for the management of Hypertension. Key recommendations include: ACE inhibitors are common first-line. Reduce sodium intake. For more detailed information, consult the official General publications.
